subject: Collective Bargaining Strategy
overview: The School Committee met and voted to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining strategy for several district employee units.

items.title: Opening and Attendance
items.summary: The meeting was called to order and attendance was established through a roll call.

items.title: Motion to Enter Executive Session
items.summary: Approved a motion to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining strategy for teachers, paraprofessionals, administrative assistants, and administrators.
